reasons.plausibility: The core idea that refining grain size by controlling deposition temperature can broaden a first-order magnetostructural transition and reduce hysteresis is consistent with known microstructure–property relationships in magnetic alloys, though the degree of impact on magnetocaloric properties may vary.
reasons.testability: A clear experimental design is proposed with a control (standard deposition) and a variable (lower-temperature deposition) and measurable outcomes (grain size, hysteresis, transition breadth) that directly test the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: It provides a practical route for modifying both microstructure and ordering to potentially improve magnetocaloric performance under relevant operating conditions, which is valuable for researchers in this field.
